bahrain.title: Shura committee set to reject 80% Bahrainisation rule for government project contractors
bahrain.summary: A proposal to make private firms on government and privatisation contracts employ Bahrainis for at least 80% of their workforce is expected to be rejected by the Shura Council, which debates it in its weekly session on Sunday.

bahrain.title: Golden Residency property applications more than double after lower threshold
bahrain.summary: The number of Golden Residency holders who qualified through property has more than doubled since the minimum real estate investment was cut from BD 200,000 to BD 130,000 last year. New partner benefits are also being added to the scheme.

bahrain.title: Unified inspection system proposed so one visit covers all regulators
bahrain.summary: A Northern Municipal Council member has proposed a Smart Inspection Platform and Unified Inspection Licence, letting several authorities check a business for violations in one unannounced visit instead of separate inspections, to cut duplication and tighten oversight.

bahrain.title: Shura to debate law recognising digital consent in electronic transactions
bahrain.summary: Government-drafted amendments already passed by Parliament would recognise digital consent in dealings with government bodies and private businesses, making electronic transactions easier. A Shura committee has recommended approval ahead of the debate.

bahrain.title: Expanded North Sitra sewage treatment plant opens
bahrain.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Shaikh Khalid bin Abdulla Al Khalifa inaugurated the development and expansion of the North Sitra Sewage Treatment Plant, part of efforts to upgrade infrastructure to meet current and future demand.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Development Bank launches BDB Plus services package for SMEs
bahrain.summary: BDB Plus gives small and medium businesses discounted non-financial services from local partners, including Batelco business communication and hardware packages and EazyPay point-of-sale systems.

bahrain.title: Bahrain climbs to fourth worldwide in UN telecom infrastructure index
bahrain.summary: Bahrain rose six places to fourth globally in the Telecommunications Infrastructure Index of the UN E-Government Survey 2026, scoring 0.998 out of 1.

bahrain.title: Traffic advice for Sakhir as exhibitions draw heavy crowds
bahrain.summary: With Jewellery Arabia, Scent Arabia and Cityscape Bahrain busy at Exhibition World, traffic police advise visitors to turn left at the lights towards Bahrain International Circuit and park at P7, P8 or P9, where shuttle buses run to the venue.

crypto.title: Binance restores all withdrawals four weeks after $6.3 billion hack
crypto.summary: Binance lifted all hack-related withdrawal suspensions, ending a phased recovery that began on 1 November. The 29 October hot wallet attack, attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, was the largest crypto theft on record, and Binance set aside over $6.34 billion to cover losses.

crypto.title: Stablecoin sceptic Hernandez de Cos set to become next ECB president
crypto.summary: BIS chief Pablo Hernandez de Cos has majority backing from eurozone governments to replace Christine Lagarde on 7 February, the FT reports. He favours tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and supports a digital euro, which is due for a 2027 pilot.

crypto.title: Spain plans to let anti-laundering unit freeze crypto accounts without a judge
crypto.summary: A decree published on 25 November would let Sepblac suspend crypto accounts for up to five business days and hold transactions for up to 10 without court approval, from 25 January 2027. Congress must ratify it within 30 days, and firms that do not comply face fines from EUR 150,000.

crypto.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody hit by data breach
crypto.summary: Zodia Custody said an intruder accessed business contact names and emails of a small number of clients and staff after probing its platform. It briefly took its business API offline and found no unauthorised transactions. Standard Chartered agreed last month to absorb the unit.

crypto.title: New York wins $1.37 billion judgment against NovaTech founders
crypto.summary: New York's attorney general won a $1.367 billion judgment against Cynthia and Eddy Petion, founders of collapsed crypto and forex firm NovaTech, over a Ponzi scheme that targeted immigrant, mainly Haitian, communities. The couple had fled the country.

crypto.title: Binance plans tokenized IPO programme once regulators approve
crypto.summary: Binance co-CEO Yi He said the exchange will run a professional onchain IPO process for tokenized shares after regulatory approval, as part of its real-world asset strategy. It is already hiring equity capital markets staff.
